reports.title: Louisiana coastal and Little River Basin survey

scope.name: Coastal Louisiana below U.S. Highway 90 and Little River Basin
scope.description: Agency coastal-zone and Little River Basin survey areas; not a statewide Louisiana census. A state outline is only a report reference.

reports.method: Aircraft observations expanded to regional population estimates under the agency survey program. Counts from one observer on three southwest transects were not recorded in this survey.

quality.label: Partial survey
quality.note: A recording failure lost one observer's counts on southwest Louisiana transects 8-10. The southwest and overall estimates are incomplete; the size of the undercount is unknown.

summary.mallardCountNote: The original table's mallard row is blank; no mallard estimate is supplied.
summary.allDucksDefinition: Original TOTAL DUCKS row. It excludes the black-bellied whistling ducks discussed separately in the narrative.

habitat.description: Agency describes much of southwest Louisiana and Little River Basin as extremely dry; coastal marsh conditions and water levels generally near average.

provenance.counts: PDF page 1, species table MOTTLED, BW TEAL, and TOTAL DUCKS rows; asterisks identify partial-data estimates.
provenance.quality: PDF page 1, table footnote and Survey Limitation paragraph: recording failure along transects 8-10.
provenance.habitat: PDF page 2, first full habitat paragraph.
provenance.countDefinition: PDF page 2, black-bellied whistling duck paragraph explicitly excludes those birds from the table.

notes: This September report is dated seasonal context, not a current November bird count or a mallard migration signal.
The 89,000 printed table estimate is partial; do not treat it as a fully comparable trend or infer an exact population from it.
Blank table cells remain unknown rather than observed zeros. The narrative separately states that no green-winged teal were observed.
The narrative lists 20,000 partial southwest and 1,000 southeast black-bellied whistling duck estimates outside the table total. These were not added to TOTAL DUCKS.
The table also marks some Little River Basin species estimates as less than 1,000; no exact values were fabricated.
